segment.source: ::An imposing silver-furred rathound stands before you in all its glory.::<end>
segment.target: ::An imposing silver-furred rathound stands before you in all its glory.::<end>

segment.source: ::Its red eyes stare at you with noticeable apprehension. Something about your appearance is confusing the creature.::<end>
segment.target: ::Its red eyes stare at you with noticeable apprehension. Something about your appearance is confusing the creature.::<end>

segment.source: ::You can sense that this creature is psionically active.::<end>
segment.target: ::You can sense that this creature is psionically active.::<end>

segment.source: ::Strut your stuff in an attempt to establish dominance.::<end>
segment.target: ::Strut your stuff in an attempt to establish dominance.::<end>

segment.source: ::The creature backs up a few steps. It stops growling and lowers its head in, what you assume, is an act of submission.::<end>
segment.target: ::The creature backs up a few steps. It stops growling and lowers its head in, what you assume, is an act of submission.::<end>

segment.source: ::After a few moments, the creature takes off.::<end>
segment.target: ::After a few moments, the creature takes off.::<end>

segment.source: ::Your feeble attempts at looking more menacing than a giant rathound only make the creature angrier.::<end>
segment.target: ::Your feeble attempts at looking more menacing than a giant rathound only make the creature angrier.::<end>

segment.source: ::You lock into a mental struggle with the creature and manage to subdue it.::<end>
segment.target: ::You lock into a mental struggle with the creature and manage to subdue it.::<end>

segment.source: ::You lock into a mental struggle with the creature, but unfortunately it comes up on top, angrier than before.::<end>
segment.target: ::You lock into a mental struggle with the creature, but unfortunately it comes up on top, angrier than before.::<end>

segment.source: ::Its red eyes are glaring at you as it growls aggressively.::<end>
segment.target: ::Its red eyes are glaring at you as it growls aggressively.::<end>

segment.source: ::It watches you passively for a moment before going back to what it was doing.::<end>
segment.target: ::It watches you passively for a moment before going back to what it was doing.::<end>
